title: Unusable
body: Full of bugs. Won’t even allow me to create a task.
author: Millieroro

title: Too Buggy
body: It has so much promise but it’s far too buggy. Crashes every time I try to use study buddy, notifications come up that say “text” instead of actual descriptions, unable to add your own categories for the to-do list, and more issues. I’ve unsubscribed and actually want a refund since it doesn’t perform as promised. If bugs could be ironed out and it performs as promised, it would be a great app. It needs work though.
author: Alexandra-O

title: App issues
body: This app has great potential and I’ve been eagerly awaiting its release for so long but sadly there are a few bugs that mean I can’t use it properly right now. Things like the Study Budy and music/soundscapes don’t work and as soon as I select them the app crashes. Just leaving this review as feedback so the issues can be fixed and then I’ll happily come back for another try :) thanks for what you’re doing guys!
author: kimbadais

title: Poor communication
body: Have emailed customer service at least 3 times with no acknowledgment or response
author: Tangoqww

title: I intend to update this rating when bug fixes make the app 100% useable
body:
I’m very excited for this app. Unfortunately the to do or “smart focus” function isn’t working. I made sure my software is updated on my iPhone & iPad. Have re-download the app to make sure I troubleshoot on my end. With two devices no luck in getting the functionality on the to-do check list to be marked complete. 
I have emailed about this bug in the app message function. I have cancelled my subscription within the trail and will come back and try again once i can see that the initial bug fixes have been resolved.
Once i can fully use the app I intend to update this review as I’ve been very excited in anticipation of the focus genie app release. I understand that these things should happen but wanted to communicate this slight problem and hopefully see when it’s corrected.
The visuals and other functionality looks exciting and I’m so keen to drive right in !!
author: Shadow Chic
